The story depicts the summer vacation of a second-year high school student, and the story progresses to the next day by interacting with childhood friends and family and avoiding tragedy.

en.title: FGO’s 10th anniversary, I am the witness
en.summary: When asked what the most impressive plot in "Fate/Grand Order" was, player Xiao Huang thought for a long time and told a story about the Dinos. That is Chapter 2.7 "Journey to the Sea of ​​Golden Trees". On the last day of the world's destruction, the Dinos (a highly intelligent dinosaur species set in the plot), who are set to follow absolute rationality, led by their king, launched a charge against the final boss, ORT, in order to protect Chaldea who came to "destroy their world". This absolutely losing battle is pointless and defies reason. But in the short time they spent with the Chaldeans, they understood the imperfections of the human species and fell in love with the emotions brought about by this imperfection. So they decided to abandon reason and decide to act on emotion. In the end, this sacrifice moved Kukulkan so much that he transformed the false sun into the true god. The story has also been completed - the mythless Dinos were created.

ja.summary: 何を見てるんですか？画面の向こうにいる友人、調子はどうですか？再び「エンジンを使ってゲームをプレイする」時代が来ました。ここでは、私が試したさまざまなゲームについて 1 ～ 2,000 語で簡単に説明します。その中には、時代の舵をゆっくりと歩んでいく作品もあれば、戦争の霧の中で踊る作品もある。大胆でユニークで絶妙なもの、あるいは時代遅れで時代遅れで保守的なもの。好むと好まざるにかかわらず、私がこのゲームの何に惹かれたのかを正直に話します。したがって、私のゲーム体験を共有するこの記事シリーズでは、どこでプレイしても、思いついたことを何でも書いていきます。これは 7,000 語や 8,000 語の詳細なレビューでも、数十語の短いレビューでもありません。簡単に言うと、エンジンはゲームをプレイしているので、私がプレイした内容について時間を見つけてお話ししたいと思います。ということで、今日プレイしたいゲームは「Japanese One」「Yakai」開発チームの最新作「Quiet Pastoral」です。本作の最大の特徴は、『イェ・フイ』の「優しくて可愛くてひねくれた闇」を融合させた点です。

en.title: Even if you don’t do anything wrong, evil spirits are knocking on the door | Play the new work "Quiet Pastoral" by the "Yehui" group!

Among these works, some are slowly walking behind the wheel of the times, and some are dancing in the fog of war. They are bold, unique, and exquisite, or they are old-fashioned, old-fashioned, and conservative. Whether I like it or not, I will honestly tell you what attracted me to the game.
